'''Ghormanians''',<ref name="Do No Harm" /> also known as the '''Ghormanese'''<ref name="Technical" /> were the natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]]. Ghorman was represented by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gebnerret Vibrion]], who served as the planet's [[Senator/Legends|senator]] under both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Do No Harm" />
